text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, like any other day, I find myself 
accompanying Mr. C.B. on her whimsical 
stroll.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, walking a lot feels so refreshing! 
How about you?
choice_data_list:
It's nice taking a stroll without any 
destination in mind.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? Didn't I tell you? Today is—

Geez, what a mess~! I was just wandering 
around and somehow ended up all the way 
out here!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Maybe Royce is just too much of a "free 
spirit." Seriously! She was only acting on 
a whim!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh. In that case, you should try some 
Hachimi! That's what I came here for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
? Why so surprised? I've been in the mood 
for Hachimi all day!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad we made it here okay. The 
Hachimi here is delicious, you know."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Some days you have a goal, other days you 
don't. Isn't that what being a "free 
spirit" is all about!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: What... absolute freedom...!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Grrr, I can't let it end like this!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ? Not a fan of Hachimi?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, everywhere they went on their 
walk—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Felt like it, so off to the art museum! 
There are days like that, especially for a 
'free spirit'!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look, a fountain! I thought I heard water. 
I'm so glad we took a detour.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Gh!!!! Was it just a coincidence this 
time...ugh?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just to fish? ...No. That "free spirit" 
wouldn't do something so simple. Then what 
on earth is it for...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's you again.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The waves are rough here, so you shouldn't 
swim. I was just stopped by some anglers a 
moment ago, too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You tried to swim without any 
preparation...?! Even for you, there's a 
limit to being carefree...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The finale of the walk turned out to be 
mountain climbing. I felt glad I had 
packed various gear like climbing boots 
just in case. Just as I thought that—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I... I found it... N-Now... maybe I 
should... sing a song... here...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Kyuu~~...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to master the "free spirit" 
persona. As part of my self-branding, you 
see...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To master it, you've gotta beat the 
academy's #1 "free spirit" in a contest, 
right? But—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Total defeat. What a bitter regret.
choice_data_list:
You don't have to fixate on winning and 
losing that much...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't know much about competition, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Today's walk was quite thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing a perspective I didn't have was 
really interesting. Next time, let's walk 
together from the very start!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
M-My eyes...!! How... how can someone be 
so refreshing...?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I was mistaken from the start. 
CB-san's charm isn't just about being a 
'free spirit'.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to... this natural-born 
charm!!
choice_data_list:
Think you can use this for your 
self-producing?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've seared that lovely smile into my 
memory! Now all that's left is to go back 
and practice my expressions!!
choice_data_list:
(Is it really okay to judge based on 
facial expression alone...?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well then, I'll be rooting for you. 
Seeing you work so hard right now... it's 
quite charming.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've noticed, I have to study it! 
C.B.-san, please let me run with you 
again!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Exciting things are always welcome. I'm 
looking forward to our walk together.
